steps: Wash the okra and pat it completely dry.
Cut the okra into short pieces.
Fry the okra in half the oil on medium heat until it is no longer sticky, then set it aside.
In the rest of the oil, let the cumin sizzle, then fry the onion and green chilli until golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for a minute.
Add the tomato and salt and cook until soft and mushy.
Mix in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala with a splash of water.
Fold in the okra and crushed kasuri methi, cook uncovered on low for 5 minutes, and top with coriander leaves.
note: The sources use 85 to 125 g of okra a person; 100 g sits in the middle. Garlic is light because only one source uses it.
